_doc: stackprov_r27.py R5: windows that no provenance rule (ring geometry, extractor version, published record, byte-identical content) decides. kind='winner': a declared winner among tied products; kind='prerepair': a CENSUS window whose only product in the stack's inventory is on the pre-repair annulus, declared with the reason no repaired product can be read. Every declaration must be used (a stale one stops the build).
